This role combines procurement administration, international purchasing coordination, import compliance, supplier communication, and logistics support to ensure that goods and materials are sourced, transported, and delivered according to organizational requirements. Procurement responsibilities include identifying potential suppliers, requesting quotations, comparing prices, reviewing product specifications, and preparing purchase orders in accordance with internal procedures and budget requirements. The officer coordinates purchasing approvals, monitors order status, confirms product availability, and follows up on delivery schedules. Duties also include maintaining procurement records, reviewing purchasing documentation, tracking expenditure, and identifying opportunities to improve cost efficiency and purchasing processes while maintaining appropriate quality standards. Import responsibilities involve coordinating international shipments, preparing and reviewing import documentation, and communicating with suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and logistics providers. The officer assists with monitoring shipment schedules, verifying invoices and packing lists, coordinating shipping arrangements, and ensuring that required documentation is complete. Additional duties include tracking customs clearance progress, maintaining import records, monitoring delivery updates, and escalating discrepancies or delays to the appropriate parties. The role supports compliance with applicable import procedures, customs requirements, and organizational policies. Supplier relations responsibilities include establishing and maintaining professional communication with suppliers, coordinating supplier inquiries, monitoring delivery performance, and supporting the evaluation of supplier reliability. The officer assists with maintaining supplier databases, reviewing quotations, tracking outstanding orders, and coordinating the resolution of issues involving product quality, pricing, documentation, or delivery schedules. Duties also include communicating purchasing requirements, collecting updated supplier information, supporting supplier performance reviews, and identifying potential sourcing opportunities. The role helps maintain constructive supplier relationships and supports continuity of supply. The position works closely with procurement teams, finance departments, warehouse personnel, logistics providers, and external suppliers to coordinate purchasing and import activities. The officer prepares procurement reports, maintains accurate transaction records, monitors shipment progress, and ensures that relevant documentation is properly organized. Through effective procurement coordination, accurate import administration, and proactive supplier relationship management, the role contributes to cost control, timely deliveries, supply chain transparency, and operational efficiency. Qualifications Diploma or degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics, International Business, Business Administration, or a related field. Understanding of procurement procedures, supplier management, import coordination, and international shipping processes. Ability to prepare purchase orders, request quotations, compare supplier offers, and maintain purchasing records. Knowledge of import documentation, commercial invoices, packing lists, shipping documents, and customs clearance procedures. Familiarity with international trade requirements, Incoterms, import regulations, and relevant compliance documentation. Ability to coordinate with suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal departments. Familiarity with enterprise resource planning systems, procurement platforms, spreadsheets, and inventory management software. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including professional supplier correspondence. Excellent organizational and time-management abilities, with the capacity to monitor multiple orders and shipment schedules. Strong attention to detail when reviewing quotations, invoices, shipping documents, and purchase records. Analytical and problem-solving skills to identify procurement discrepancies, delivery delays, and supply chain risks. Ability to compare supplier pricing, monitor purchasing costs, and support cost-effective sourcing decisions. Strong negotiation, coordination, and relationship-building skills. Commitment to accurate documentation, ethical procurement practices, confidentiality, and compliance with established procedures. Ability to work collaboratively across departments and support continuous improvement in procurement and import operations.
